wei-ask-house-investigate-northern-wei-a.player_statement: Have House Tang verify these latest reports about the northern Wei operation before I approach Qin again. I want to know what material action actually settled, what can be established about the forces, movement, supply, authority and result, which parts are confirmed and which remain rumor, and whether anything in it bears on the recommendation the Qin Military Bureau made for me. At the same time, give me a detailed accounting of the Great Bow Guard recruitment so far: how many applicants we actually have, how many have been screened, accepted or rejected if any, what has been spent or committed on recruiting, screening, training and equipment, what future costs are already implied, and what that leaves against the House's treasury-safe ceiling.
wei-ask-house-investigate-northern-wei-a.response_summary: Tang Ling completes the House review requested from the delivered northern-operation report. The military information available to this House review remains the report already received: Reports reaching Tang Wei through merchants, court reports, military dispatches, price and troop movement concern major Qin operation against northern Wei while Qin court power is divided. The latest report describes material domain work that actually settled. House accounts place the current discretionary treasury-safe ceiling at 4370400 silver after protecting 10536000 silver of stable expense reserve. Great Bow Guard applicant intake is open. The current House program record establishes 0 accepted fighters and 0 silver committed by the opening itself; it does not yet register separate applicant, screened, or rejected totals, so those figures cannot be claimed from the records. Sword Manor has no current trainee vacancy; its next normal review is not presently scheduled. This review establishes planning information only; it creates no Qin appointment or deployment order and does not claim enemy dispositions beyond the delivered report.

result.knowledge_boundary: No enemy disposition is established beyond the committed player-visible source report.

The two programs remain institutionally separate, so one does not consume the other's authorized fighting establishment.
